title: 30 mins after lighting, a strong horrible chemical smell is produced.
text:
30 mins after lighting, a strong horrible chemical smell is produced.. [[VIDEOID:c9df976906c795be6585caee653dd2e8]] 2, no 3 things... it’s overall a clean smelling candle.
1. The 2 wicks when lit burn very oddly. No air flow in our room when candles are lit.
2. I occasionally get a “chemical smell” when ONLY this candle is burning, usually around 30 mins after lighting the candle. Whew stinky
3. NO LID, every candle Should have a lid. The lid protects the candle from dust and pet hair
